newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Lucent plans cellular plant in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Lucent plans cellular plant in Brazil.

text.p: Lucent Technologies Inc. said Monday it plans to build a cellular equipment manufacturing plant and global provisioning centre in Brazil, boosting its investment in the country to over $100 million.
The facility will be the first Lucent factory in Brazil and the sixth in the Caribbean & Latin America region.
Construction is slated to begin June 1. The centre will initially employ over 300 people in manufacturing and distribution operations.
Lucent expects to use the centre to locally develop the software and systems needed by its Brazilian customers and eventually to export to Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay and Uruguay.

"Our goal is to reach wireless market leadership with a 30 percent market share, and local manufacturing will help us get there," said Virgilio Freire, president of Lucent Technologies Network Systems do Brasil.
Lucent, spun off by AT&T Corp. in a restructuring in September of last year, has more than 10,000 employees in 16 countries in the Caribbean and Latin America.
Its stock rose $1.25 to $61.50 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
